description: Meest kansrijke gebieden voor windenergie provincie Utrecht is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by download.geodata-utrecht.nl. The data shows the 27 most promising areas for wind energy in the province of Utrecht (9 January 2024). Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Most promising areas for wind energy province of Utrecht" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2024-02-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
